album.title: Radif Navazi - Tar: Abu Ata, Afshari

just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on Gs3 and dwells most on C in Sayakhi. The line peaks at D5 (559.7 Hz) at 1:15.3. It closes on D5, not the tonic (G4 → G4 → E4 → E4 → D5 → D5).
